description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different models. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", also has a linear scale, ranging from 12 to 28, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot displays four lines, each representing a different model: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circle markers), Inconsistency-CE (magenta dashed line with square markers), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with square markers), and Consistency-Bi (red solid line with star markers). The Consistency-CE line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 13 at an AL of -1 and increases to around 27 at an AL of 7. The Inconsistency-CE line begins at a BLEU score of about 20 at an AL of 1 and rises to approximately 27 at an AL of 7. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line starts at a BLEU score of around 20 at an AL of 1 and increases to about 27 at an AL of 7. The Consistency-Bi line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 23 at an AL of -1 and increases to around 27 at an AL of 7, with a relatively steady trend across the x-axis range.
